intent: Add governed production deployment frequency and merge-to-deploy facts for issue 11

edits.new_content:
select md5(repository || '|' || cast(deployment_id as varchar) || '|' || cast(number as varchar)) as deployment_change_key,
       md5(repository || '|' || cast(deployment_id as varchar)) as deployment_key,
       repository, deployment_id, number, merged_at, merge_sha
from {{ source('raw', 'deployment_changes') }}

select d.deployment_key, d.repository, d.deployment_id, d.environment,
       d.succeeded_at, cast(d.succeeded_at at time zone 'UTC' as date) as date,
       1 as deployment_count
from {{ ref('stg_deployments') }} d
join {{ ref('stg_signal_captures') }} c
  on d.repository = c.repository and c.signal = 'deployments'
where cast(d.succeeded_at at time zone 'UTC' as date)
    < cast(c.captured_at at time zone 'UTC' as date)

with ranked as (
    select c.repository, c.number, c.merged_at, d.deployment_key, d.environment,
           d.succeeded_at, d.date,
           row_number() over (
               partition by c.repository, c.number
               order by d.succeeded_at, d.deployment_id
           ) as shipping_order
    from {{ ref('stg_deployment_changes') }} c
    join {{ ref('fct_deployments') }} d on c.deployment_key = d.deployment_key
    where c.merged_at <= d.succeeded_at
)
select md5(repository || '|' || cast(number as varchar)) as shipped_pr_key,
       repository, number, deployment_key, environment, merged_at, succeeded_at, date,
       date_diff('microsecond', merged_at, succeeded_at) / 3600000000.0 as hours_lead_time
from ranked
where shipping_order = 1
